w.INVALID_PROJECT: Faka igama leprojekthi (ukuya kutsho koonobumba abayi-100). Idilesi ingaba noonobumba abayi-191.
w.name: Igama
w.projectsDesc: Fumana iprojekthi uze ubone umsebenzi wamva nje.
w.allDesc: Zonke iirekhodi zakho zomsebenzi kwindawo enye.
w.excelHint: Ifoto enye kumqolo ngamnye, kunye neprojekthi, ilungu, ixesha lokufota, indawo nekhonkco lokujonga.
w.excelNote: Iquka imifanekiso emincinci yeefoto, ukuya kutsho kwi-90 KB ngamnye nezinto eziyi-200 ngokukhuphela ngakunye. Ukuba umfanekiso awufumaneki, iinkcukacha zawo nekhonkco lokujonga ziyagcinwa.
w.downloadBrowserHint: Jonga uluhlu lokukhutshelwayo phezulu ekunene kwisikhangeli sakho. Ukuba ifayile ayikho, cofa kuKhuphela kwakhona.
w.shareCopied: Ikhonkco likotshiwe. Lincamathisele ukuze wabelane nabanye.
w.shareCopyManual: Akukwazekanga ukukopa ngokuzenzekela. Khetha ikhonkco elingentla uze ulikope ngokwakho.
w.shareTeamScope: Nabani na oneli khonkco angajonga zonke iifoto neevidiyo zeli qela ngaphandle kokungena kwiakhawunti.
w.shareProjectScope: Nabani na oneli khonkco angajonga zonke iifoto neevidiyo zale projekthi ngaphandle kokungena kwiakhawunti.
w.shareMemberScope: Nabani na oneli khonkco angajonga iifoto neevidiyo ezifakwe ngulo mntu kuwo onke amaqela ngaphandle kokungena kwiakhawunti.
w.shareUnfiltered: Ikhonkco liquka nezinto eziza kufakwa kamva kwaye alisebenzisi izihluzo zakho zangoku.
w.noPhotosDesc: Zama ezinye izihluzo, okanye fota uze ufake iifoto kweli qela kwi-app ye-Timeprint.
w.noTeamDesc: Yenza iqela kwiisetingi okanye ujoyine iqela kwi-app.
w.imageFailed: Imboniselo yangaphambili ayifumaneki. Zama ukukhuphela ifayile.
w.author: Ifotwe ngu
w.exportDesc: Iifayile zilungiselelwa ngasemva kwaye zigcinwa iintsuku eziyi-7.
w.directExportNote: Gcina eli phepha livuliwe de kukhutshelwe i-ZIP. Ukuya kutsho kwiifayile eziyi-200 ne-100 MB ngokukhuphela ngakunye. Ukuba ifayile ayifundeki, ungazama kwakhona.
w.directExportHistory: Iifayile ze-ZIP ezikhutshelweyo zigcinwa kwisixhobo sakho. Apha kuvela kuphela okuthunyelwa ngaphandle okulungiselelwa ngasemva.
w.exportDownloadStarted: Ukukhuphela i-“{filename}” kuqalile. Yifumane kuluhlu lokukhutshelwayo lwesikhangeli sakho.
w.DIRECT_EXPORT_LIMIT: Khuphela ukuya kwiifayile eziyi-200 ngexesha. Khetha iqela elincinci.
w.DIRECT_EXPORT_SIZE_LIMIT: Iifayile ezikhethiweyo zingaphezu kwe-100 MB. Khuphela iqela elincinci.
w.EXPORT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Ukuthumela ngaphandle ngasemva akukalungi. Qhagamshelana nomlawuli wakho.
w.EXPORT_FAILED: Ifayile ayikwazanga ukwenziwa. Zama kwakhona kungekudala.
w.EXPORT_TIMEOUT: Liphelile ixesha lokulungiselela ukukhuphela. Nceda uzame kwakhona.
w.exportNote: Thumela iifayile ezifumanekayo ngaphandle, ukuya kwiifayile eziyi-2000 ne-2 GB ngomsebenzi ngamnye. Iifayile ezingaphumelelanga zidweliswe kwirekhodi lokuthunyelwa ngaphandle.
w.noExportsDesc: Khetha iifoto kwithala, uze ukhethe uThumela njenge-ZIP.
w.projectNote: Amalungu eqela akhoyo ajoyina iprojekthi. Ukufikelela kwiifoto kusalandela indima yawo kwiqela.
w.SCOPE_CHANGED: Iifoto okanye ufikelelo zitshintshile. Hlaziya uze ukhethe kwakhona.
w.EXPORT_LIMIT: Thumela ukuya kwiifayile eziyi-2000 ngaphandle ngexesha. Nciphisa okukhethileyo.
w.TOO_MANY_EXPORTS: Unokuthunyelwa ngaphandle okuyi-3 okuqhubekayo. Linda okanye urhoxise okunye.
w.EXPORT_SIZE_LIMIT: Iifayile zingaphezu kwe-2 GB. Thumela ngaphandle ngamaqela amancinci.
w.STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Ukukhuphela akulungiselelwanga lo mthombo. Qhagamshelana nomlawuli weqela lakho.
w.FILE_EXPIRED: Ifayile iphelelwe lixesha. Yithumele ngaphandle kwakhona.
